MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Ethernet cables feel like a useful next choice because they could help me use my recent USB Gigabit Ethernet adapter, though I probably do not need five.",
    "The USB hub fits my history of connecting accessories, and the wired network card recognizes my networking interest, but neither gives me a reason to buy right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The internal drives, drive enclosure, and power supply assume I have a storage or desktop upgrade project, which my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "The webcam and lighting bundle does not follow from buying a tablet mount; needing to hold a tablet does not mean I need video-call equipment.",
    "Another network adapter feels redundant when my recent USB Ethernet adapter already covers my wired connection needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been treated as interest in a broad range of desktop components.",
    "My earlier WiFi adapter and tablet mount seem to have been stretched into interest in another WiFi card and webcam mounting equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase points toward making use of an existing wired adapter, so a compatible cable makes more sense than replacing that adapter.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart and serve specific purposes; a related accessory needs to solve an actual problem before I would choose it.",
    "Extra USB ports could be useful eventually, but my past USB purchases do not establish that I am currently running out of ports."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my connectivity interests but too often assume that a practical accessory purchase means I want a broader computer upgrade."
}
